## Building (Turnberry Place)
- Address: 2827 Paradise Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89109
- Four residential towers, each 38 stories (sources: Wikipedia, SkyscraperPage, CTBUH Skyscraper Center — checked 2026-11-09)
- Towers completed 2001–2006; public sources cite roughly 720–778 residential units
- Guard-gated condominium community one block east of the Las Vegas Strip
- Resident access to The Stirling Club private club on campus
